entries.en: Huh? What bootlegs? What're you talking about?
entries.ro: Cum adică? Ce bootleg-uri? Despre ce vorbești?

entries.en: The Samurai concerts. The ones you hired me to find.
entries.ro: Concertele Samurai. Cele pe care m-ai angajat să le găsesc.

entries.en: Oooooh, yeah, totally. Why didn't you say so? Shit, man, shimra. Get the wheels, too?
entries.ro: Oooooh, da, sigur. De ce nu ziceai, bă? Căcat, frate, shimra. Și mașina ai luat-o?

entries.en: Job was to get the bootlegs.
Yeah, I know, duh, but since you were already there, you could've made a lil' effort. Pff. Whatever. Thanks.
entries.ro: Da, știu, evident, dar fiindcă erai deja acolo, puteai să mai faci și tu un mic efort. Pff. Na, las'. Mersi.

entries.en: It's parked downstairs. Keys're in the ignition.
entries.ro: E parcată jos. Cheile sunt în contact.

entries.en: Whaaaaat? For real? That's fucking far out, choom. I won't forget this!
entries.ro: Whaaaaat? Pe bune? E al dracului de tare, choom. Nu o să uit asta!

entries.en: What, that not allowed? You know how hard it is when your parent's famous? You don't. Nobody does. Maybe Yorinobu Arasaka.
entries.ro: Ce, nu-i voie? Știi cât de greu e când ai părinte faimos? Nu știi. Nimeni nu știe. Poate doar Yorinobu Arasaka.

entries.en: Don't get along with your mom?
You don't get along with your mom?
Heh... You know, I don't even remember the last time I called her "mom?"
entries.ro: Heh... Știi, nici nu-mi mai amintesc ultima dată când i-am zis „mamă”.

entries.en: Don't even call her Bes Isis. Or mother. Or Nancy.
entries.ro: Nici Bes Isis nu-i zic. Sau mother. Sau Nancy.
„Incredibila, unica și inegalabila, Beees Isis!” Căcat.
